description.zh: 需要配置高精度秒级监控的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance for which you want to configure fine-grained monitoring.
The instance type. Set the value to **EIP**.
The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project.

description.zh:
实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
实例的高精度秒级监控状态。取值：

- **ON**：开启高精度秒级监控。
- **OFF**：关闭高精度秒级监控。
description.en:
The status of fine-grained monitoring. Valid values:

*   **ON**
*   **OFF**

title.zh: 为EIP配置高精度秒级监控

descriptions.zh: **SetHighDefinitionMonitorLogStatus**接口不支持同一个EIP实例并发配置高精度秒级监控。
descriptions.en: You cannot repeatedly call **SetHighDefinitionMonitorLogStatus** within a specific period of time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc set-high-definition-monitor-log-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project hdmonitor-cn-shenzhen --log-store hdmonitor --instance-id eip-wz9fi6qboho9fwgx70000 --instance-type EIP --status ON --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc SetHighDefinitionMonitorLogStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status ON --LogStore hdmonitor --InstanceId 'eip-wz9fi6qboho9fwgx70000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType EIP --LogProject 'hdmonitor-cn-shenzhen'
